name: r5-ldg256-os-r16-stel
author: solx-loop
description: The kernel keeps the parent's one-shot ldg256 structure. The only change is that output stores carry an L2 evict_last policy, while loads keep the default policy. Outputs stay in L2 longer, and the used-once input lines and the harness's flush lines are evicted first. That should cut DRAM write traffic and read/write mixing inside the timed window, and leave more output dirty in L2 when the kernel ends.
